Q001.question: Han muc chuyen tien P2P moi ngay cua tai khoan Tier 2 la bao nhieu?
Q001._vi_sao_chon: Cau da chung minh vector thuan that bai va la ly do ky thuat sinh ra hybrid search: BRD-002 NOI VE chuyen tien P2P nen gan query ve ngu nghia; BR-002 CHUA con so.
Q001.ket_qua: BR-002 KHONG lot top-3 voi vector thuan (vector_score 0.387, thua ca ba chunk van xuoi). BM25 cham no 13.49 nho token hiem '20.000.000' va ma 'BR-002' trong context header, keo len hang 2.

ket_luan: Hybrid search nang Recall@3 tu 54% len 89% (+35 diem phan tram) tren 28 cau. Day la cai tien lon nhat cua ca du an.
PHAN RA DONG GOP (ablation cong don 4 arm): metadata filter +1 cau, BM25 +9 cau, table boost +1 cau. BM25 chiem 82% muc tang — no la ky thuat quyet dinh, khong phai metadata filter.

Nhom huong loi nhieu nhat la table_numeric: 17% -> 83%. Dung nhu chan doan — embedding phan biet duoc tai lieu NOI VE X nhung khong phan biet duoc tai lieu CHUA GIA TRI cua X; bang so toan token hiem nen BM25 an diem.
SUA MOT GIA THUYET SAI: version_conflict 33% -> 100% KHONG phai do metadata filter. Arm vector_filter van dung o 1/3; Q026 va Q027 chi duoc cuu khi co BM25.

Metadata filter dong gop it O THANG DO NAY, nhung do la HAN CHE CUA RECALL@3 chu khong phai cua filter: BR-002-v1 chiem suat top-3 o 5/28 cau khi khong loc, ma Recall@3 khong phat dieu do. Xem canh_bao_recall_khong_do_duoc_filter.
single_source va version_conflict ve 100% ngay tu Tuan 5 va giu nguyen qua Tuan 7, Tuan 8 — hai nhom nay het cho cai thien o tang truy xuat.
Cot hybrid_boost 93% KHONG phai ket qua Tuan 5; no la trang thai hien tai (TABLE_BOOST them o Tuan 7). Moc lich su Tuan 5 la 89%.
